parent_programme.relationship: successor robustness audit; does not alter the frozen Phase-II result

scientific_question: When a binary BAM counterfactual decision is identified inside the declared finite candidate universe, how strongly does that conclusion depend on excluding nearby same-G BAM decompositions from the world universe?

objects.same_G_completion_universe: C(G) = all binary triples (A,B,M) on the same finite node set satisfying A intersect B intersect M = G
objects.release_A_decision: 1 if (B intersect M) contains any node outside G, else 0
objects.release_B_decision: 1 if (A intersect M) contains any node outside G, else 0
objects.release_M_decision: 1 if (A intersect B) contains any node outside G, else 0
objects.axis_state_distance: Hamming distance across all 3 x |X| binary A/B/M node states
objects.completion_flip_margin: minimum axis-state Hamming distance from any current E1 survivor to any same-G completion with the opposite binary release decision; 0 when the current E1 survivor fiber is already decision-divergent

theorem_targets.statement: For any finite X and proper current distribution G subset X, the complete same-G decomposition universe C(G) contains both binary outcomes for every single-axis release decision.
theorem_targets.corollary: No nontrivial single-axis binary release decision is identified from G alone under unrestricted BAM decomposition completion.

theorem_targets.statement: For an identified release-axis decision, the exact nearest opposite-decision same-G completion has a closed-form Hamming margin: if release already expands, one edit is required for each outside-G node in the released map; if it does not expand, minimize over outside-G nodes the edits needed to set the two retained axes to 1 and the released axis to 0.

For a decision-identified E1 survivor fiber, the world-universe robustness margin is the minimum single-world flip margin over its survivors. The decision is stable to arbitrary same-G completion additions at Hamming radius strictly below this margin and can be reversed at the margin.

verification.small_universe_exhaustion: exhaustively enumerate every A/B/M decomposition for finite fixtures up to three nodes and verify C1-C3 against brute force
verification.frozen_benchmark: apply the exact margin to the unchanged 12-system / 768-truth E1 survivor fibers from Phase II

primary_outputs: identified versus unresolved binary decisions by release axis
completion flip-margin distribution for every identified binary decision
fraction of identified decisions with margin 1, 2, 3, or larger
maximum and median margin by axis
fraction of declared-universe identified decisions that are nontrivial and therefore become unresolved under complete decomposition closure
interpretation_rule: The completion margin measures logical dependence on the declared BAM world-family boundary. It does not assign probability or ecological plausibility to undeclared completions.
stop_rules: Do not label arbitrary same-G completions ecologically plausible.
Do not reinterpret the Phase-II 82.8 percent decision-identification result as invalid; it remains exact conditional on its declared universe.
Do not tune the 12 systems, E1 fibers, release targets or distance metric after scoring.
Do not add a named species to rescue or strengthen a margin pattern.
Do not claim novelty for generic robust decision making, structural uncertainty, imprecise probability or model-set sensitivity.
candidate_contribution: An exact BAM-specific robustness certificate for how far a declared occurrence-conditioned survivor fiber is from an undeclared same-G decomposition that reverses a counterfactual ecological decision.
